entities.name: Frédéric Auguste Ferdinand Thomas de Reiffenberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Frédéric Auguste Ferdinand Thomas de Reiffenberg was a baron, Belgian writer, historian-medievalist, and linguist. He was also a member of the Royal Academy of Science, Letters and Fine Arts of Belgium, as well as a member of the Academic Senate and professor at the State University of Leuven.
